title: Grav API plugin from 1.0.16 before 1.1.11 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows scoped API key…
description: The Grav API plugin versions from 1.0.16 up to but not including 1.1.11 contain an authorization bypass vulnerability. This flaw allows holders of scoped API keys to override page permission rules because the system checks the owning account's authority rather than the API key's specific scopes. Consequently, attackers with keys minted on super-admin accounts can perform unauthorized edits, deletions, or reads on pages that normally deny such actions. Similarly, media-scoped keys can be used to modify media on pages that are intended to be read-only.
